ACKNOWLEDGMENTS
===============

PRPOL gratefully uses the following third-party OpenSCAD libraries.
Thank you to each author for sharing their work with the community.

— The PRPOL team, July 2026

Gears Library (Getriebe.scad)
─────────────────────────────
  Author  : Dr Jörg Janssen (janssen86)
  Version : 2.3 (29 October 2018)
  Source  : https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:1604369
  License : Creative Commons — Attribution, Non Commercial, Share Alike
            http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/

  Provides the mathematical foundation for involute spur gears,
  herringbone gears, bevel gears, worms, racks, and planetary
  gearboxes.  The English wrapper (gears.scad) is built on top
  of this library.


Threads Library (threads.scad)
──────────────────────────────
  Author  : Ryan A. Colyer
  Version : 2.1 (2016–2017)
  Source  : https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:1686322
  License : CC0 (public domain)
            https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

  Provides standard metric thread profiles and helical sweep
  routines used throughout PRPOL's threaded parts.


Extrude Along Path (path_extrude.scad)
──────────────────────────────────────
  Author  : David Eccles (gringer)
  Years   : 2014–2019
  Source  : https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:186660
  License : CC BY-SA 4.0
            https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

  Provides the path_extrude() module used for sweeping
  arbitrary 2D profiles along 3D paths.


— The PRPOL team, July 2026
